subject: STABLE step 2: render_encoder.inc f4e8f0e0 (+bytes= counter); render_pipeline.inc 119189b0, library_frontend.inc 4f380d64 unchanged
body: Step 2 adds only a set*Bytes call counter (TEGU_PERF_ENCODE ... plan_hit= plan_miss= bytes=): each setVertexBytes/setFragmentBytes is a fresh GPU BO alloc+map (newBufferWithBytes); I did NOT change that (an arena would change the planner shape length_class/offset and risk a translator plan variant refusal) - the device bytes= value decides whether it matters. Gates after step 2: CA test ASan+release PASS (verify on, no MEMO_MISMATCH), render harness rc0; device-flag -fsyntax-only -Werror rc0 with and without TILE_FETCH/JM_BATCH defaults. SUGGESTION for render lead (bridge/n2r, yours): native indexed draws for attribute-fetch shaders. nord2_render_resources.inc:125 refuses q->index when sh->attribute_count; Valhall IDVS fetches attributes by index natively (primitive.index_type is already emitted for vertex-pulling). Admitting it (vertex range = whole remaining vertex buffer since indices may be blit-written later in the command) removes CPU expansion + expand arena + tegu_dispatch_reexpand, and lifts the VertexIndex-with-expansion refusal (-13). Encoder side would be a small change in drawIndexedPrimitives that I can do once n2r accepts it.
